name: Signature Holo

components.companion: her aligned Elder Dragon, Fulgora, filling the shattered windows behind her with its head thrust into the hall, electric-gold and arc-white scales, wreathed in crackling static, wings like sheets of storm-cloud laced with lightning
components.wearing: a layered, ethereal outfit of sheer, frosted {{PRIMARY}} fabric over a matte underlayer, with delicate {{MAGIC}} glowing fibre-optic threads woven throughout, secured at the shoulders, no headwear, her hair fully visible; a thin bikini-style top and a short, skimpy, intricate bottom with a few short fringes hanging down, the whole outfit translucent so the shape beneath is softly visible
components.pose: She stands with the staff planted and her free hand cupped around a fierce ball of lightning at chest height, her hair lifted by static, chin lifted, an intense, knowing gaze straight to the camera; full figure visible.
components.effects: Forks of lightning strike through the tall windows and run along the copper coils, the floor sigil blazes with {{MAGIC}} light, arcs dance between her hands and the staff and loose sparks hang in the air.
components.headwear: a forked crown of {{PRIMARY}} metal crackling with small arcs of lightning
components.back: a cape of storm-grey silk threaded with copper wire that crackles with static

notes: HOLO edition 'Stormbringer': the Signature scene re-authored with an ascended pose, upgraded signature weapon, crown, mantle, grander magic and a closer dragon. Holo shader/foil is applied in the client, not baked in.
